posts.headline: The Clown Show quietly sits at 4-2 with 816.12 points, and btkempski's Alaskan Bull Worm act is somehow backed by actual production for once.
posts.detail: A career 15-13 record and average finish of 4 says 'forgettable,' but this scoring total ranks top-three in the league — time to start taking the delusional Packers routine seriously.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's fraud trial just got a guilty verdict — 1-5 is now a full six games of evidence against a franchise that boasts a 20-8 career record.
posts.detail: A league-best 1.5 average finish and back-to-back top-2 seasons mean nothing when 681.58 points-for can't buy a single extra win; the pedigree is now just a punchline.

posts.headline: Thicks clings to first in the Booty Warriors at 4-2, but 721.1 points-for is still the lightest resume of any leader I've tracked in 34 straight editions.
posts.detail: A 2025 ring and a 14-14 career record only buy so much patience — the standings say contender, the box scores keep whispering fraud.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way stays buried at 2-4 with a league-low-adjacent 605.56 points, and Pharaoh23's career 10 average finish is tracking right on pace again.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record and a franchise history that's never finished better than dead last make this feel less like a slump and more like a permanent address.

posts.headline: Sasinci is 2-4 and Big Head's title defense is now officially in hospice, with the Milk Man curdling right on schedule.
posts.detail: A 2025 ring and 13-15 career record were supposed to mean something, but 710.96 points-for hasn't translated into wins — somewhere Megamind is threatening to quit the league again, probably this week.
